description: Gibraltar's GeoPortal is the government's gateway to geographic information for the British overseas territory, run by its technical services, town planning, environment and IT departments. The pages read on 2026-09-28 offer a general map viewer, a town planning viewer, 3D obstacle limitation surfaces for the airport, a 3D model and an INSPIRE viewer, and a download service exposing WMS, WFS and CSW endpoints on a GeoServer and GeoNetwork installation (download.geoportal.gov.gi) for use in desktop GIS such as QGIS; news items include a recycling bin layer by material type (2022), and the facts panel notes more than 48 km of roads and about 52 km of tunnels in the Rock. Coverage is Gibraltar. Access is free; a disclaimer page applies and no licence is stated. Caveats: the layer list was not read, and some layers may be view-only. It supports reference and exposure layers for a dense peninsula, such as buildings, roads, tunnels and airport obstacle surfaces for hazard and emergency planning. Related records: the Census of Gibraltar 2022 record gives the population and housing context.
